name: floating floor: Box 1 moves north · 1t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Box 1: 1 cell, starting at (0, 2, 1); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (0, 3, 1); Floating floor: 1 cell, starting at (0, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Floating floor.

Tick 1: Box 1 moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north; Floating floor moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
